We evaluate all models with three metrics: (1) ROUGE (Lin, 2004) -R1 and R2 compute the uni‑ and bi‑gram overlaps ... (2) BERT‑score (BS) captures far‑away dependencies ... (3) Flesch Kincaid Reading Ease (FRE) computes text readability ...

We evaluate all models with three metrics: (1) ROUGE (Lin, 2004) -R1 and R2 compute the uniand bi-gram overlaps to assess the relevance, and RL computes the longest common subsequence between reference and system summaries to find the fluency. (2) BERT-score (BS) captures faraway dependencies using contextual embeddings to compute the relevance. (3) Flesch Kincaid Reading Ease (FRE) computes text readability with the average sentence length and the average number of syllables.
